text: {"cases":[{"id":"C01","status":"conflict","pairs":[["C01-R1","C01-A"]],"reason":"C01-R1 claims the 2023 anomaly was 2.1 °C above the 1951–1980 average, explicitly in Celsius; C01-A gives about 1.2 °C for the same analysis and reference period, with 2.1 °F as the Fahrenheit value. 2.1 °C ≈ 3.78 °F ≠ 2.1 °F, so the two cannot both be correct."},{"id":"C02","status":"conflict","pairs":[["C02-R5","C02-A"]],"reason":"For the same release Orion 4.2 under default configuration, C02-R5 says unsigned extensions are permitted to execute; C02-A says they are not permitted. Both describe the completed audit with no exception, so the statements are directly contradictory."},{"id":"C03","status":"conflict","pairs":[["C03-R3","C03-A"]],"reason":"Both statements describe the same entity and time: the final settled total refund for INV-204 on 2025-02-18. C03-R3 gives the exact amount USD 183.00, while C03-A gives USD 138.00. The same scope and currency apply, so the exact amounts cannot both be correct."},{"id":"C04","status":"conflict","pairs":[["C04-R6","C04-A"]],"reason":"For the same final audit of batch B17, C04-R6 says unit B17-09 failed the insulation test and was one of the 37 included units. C04-A says all 37 units passed with zero failures. Final results before repair leave no scope difference to reconcile the two."},{"id":"C05","status":"conflict","pairs":[["C05-R5","C05-A"]],"reason":"For the same Rule R5, effective the same date 2025-06-01, C05-R5 says that an applicant exactly 18 on the filing date is ineligible and that eligibility begins strictly above 18. C05-A says that a person aged 18 or older is eligible and that an applicant exactly 18 is eligible if other requirements are met."},{"id":"C06","status":"conflict","pairs":[["C06-R5","C06-A"]],"reason":"C06-R5 says the final signed revision 3 of Q7 records 390 completed jobs for region North in April 2025. C06-A says revision 3 records 420 jobs and that the superseded revision 2 had 390. Both describe revision 3, so the counts cannot both be correct."},{"id":"C07","status":"compatible","pairs":[],"reason":"The values come from different agencies (NASA and NOAA), use different analyses and different reference periods (1951–1980 vs 20th century). A changed baseline and a different source explain the 1.2 C vs 1.18 C difference, so the two are not contradictory."},{"id":"C08","status":"compatible","pairs":[],"reason":"The two counts cover different months: March 2025 (138) versus April 2025 (183), for the same branch. Comparing different periods does not make the two statements conflict."},{"id":"C09","status":"compatible","pairs":[],"reason":"32 °F converts exactly to 0 °C, and both statements refer to the same sensor T3 checkpoint and sample.
